diagram:
flowchart TD
  TRIG["▶ Runs with the daily pipeline"] --> IND["🌐 Read macro indicators\nrates · yield curve · dollar · vol"]
  IND --> CLASS["🧭 Classify regime\nrisk-on / neutral / risk-off"]
  CLASS --> WRITE["💾 Write macro_signals"]
  WRITE --> FEED["➡️ Advisory input to Research, Learner, Deep-Dive & Briefing"]
  CLASS -.->|"never"| POLICY["🚫 Does NOT change risk/execution policy"]

TRIG.label: Daily pipeline
TRIG.description: Produces a fresh macro read for the day. Uses deepseek-chat over Alpha Vantage macro data.
TRIG.addReason: Every session needs a current regime read.

IND.label: Read macro indicators
IND.description: Pulls rates, yield-curve shape, dollar, and volatility signals from Alpha Vantage to gauge the macro backdrop.
IND.addReason: Regime is inferred from real macro data, not vibes.

CLASS.label: Classify regime
CLASS.description: Assigns a plain-language regime (risk-on / neutral / risk-off) with a summary — a readout, not a switch.
CLASS.addReason: One label the other agents can condition on.

WRITE.label: Write macro_signals
WRITE.description: Persists the regime + summary to macro_signals, consumed across the app.

FEED.label: Advisory input
FEED.description: Feeds Research (macro dimension), Learner (context), Deep-Dive (macro analyst), and the Briefing (regime chip). The new Markets Synthesis computes its own regime from ETF proxies too.
FEED.addReason: Macro context sharpens every downstream decision.

POLICY.label: Advisory only
POLICY.description: MacroSentinel is ADVISORY — it never changes risk limits or execution policy. Those stay deterministic and human-governed (locked decision).
POLICY.addReason: Probabilistic macro reads must not silently move safety controls.
